height_cost.fallback: Preserve existing road charging until a formula is approved; null is not an approved zero price.

depth_cost.relative_factor: length-weighted 1 + (depth_m / reference_depth_m) ^ exponent; preview metadata only, never charged
depth_cost.fallback: Preserve existing road charging until a price is approved; the factor is not a price.

rail_height_cost.relative_factor: length-weighted 1 + (height_m / reference_height_m) ^ exponent; preview metadata only, never charged
rail_height_cost.fallback: Rail routes stay uncharged until a price is approved; the factor is not a price.

scope: E1 elevated roads, E2 underground roads and E3a elevated rail; E3b rail trenches/tunnels and E4 central lanes are disabled
